candidate_framework: Learned challenger and conditional/object-reference solver, anchored by frozen Qwen
probe_rule: Same original query and requested view; >=2 distinct candidate Track IDs; whole probe query-track groups excluded from current training. Metadata-only reservation; probes charged within original per-query quota.
null_rule: Best constant teacher distribution within each paid probe query/view, fitted to that probe only as a reward control. It is never a student input or deployed classifier.
classic_support: H(mean Q)-mean H(Q) is the maximum available conditional teacher information. Skill=max(H(mean Q)-CE(S),0) is bounded by this gap. Reward=tanh(skill_after-skill_before) with the same probe/null both times.
actor_optimizer: Proposed fixed SGD lr.1, momentum0; one update per round, epsilon.2 policy; retain reward magnitude instead of Adam normalizing tiny teacher-confidence differences
mandatory_controls: learned vs frozen actor, identical paired-probe rules and budget
raw progress vs conditional-skill progress with matched SGD and probes
conditional vs full likelihood learner, fixed same QA paths and matched three-round optimization
object reference vs local-only learner, fixed same QA paths and matched optimization
fully fit generic joint/marginal and coarse unit/confidence soft/hard ordinary references with all same paid answers including probes
prefix: Own past/current video only; own actor and solver snapshots; no future QA or normalization
small_budget_fallback: Do not manufacture a reward when no valid pair exists; retain the learned policy/solver, fit all paid training answers, produce every query/video prediction, report no local actor feedback. Never drop a sample.
prediction_rule: All full-study raw and per-query/frame dual CountMatched outputs sealed before isolated official GT. Existing data DEV, no independent blind validation.
cost: Offline finite QA pool is research preparation, not deployment; real matched fresh independent cold cost only for a retained quality recipe.
source_implementation: Paired reservation and conditional-skill scoring plus all148 audit implemented. Integration into resumable actor/solver and full six-setting runner pending.
training_target_alignment_hypothesis: Existing collector pairs two times of one candidate; directly comparing different candidates is a distinct learning task. Inspect task time semantics, then new real cross-candidate teacher pilot before new mass collection. Old paired-time QA is not a joint comparison of different people.
proposed_conditional_utility: Two candidate utilities b_query+f_i and b_query+f_j; conditioning on exactly one removes shared b_query, leaving f_i-f_j. Both/none remain permitted in the joint model.
retain_semantic_identity_in_contrast: Eliminate query-shared nuisance b_query, retain candidate-specific stable h_i in f_i-f_j. Within-track centering of transient g alone does not teach between-candidate identity discrimination.
ordinary_fit_followup: For any future positive learner claim, audit teacher-only rare positive/argmax and exactly-one conditional fit as well as global proper KL; class imbalance can hide subgroup underfit. Existing running study gates and outputs remain unchanged; any needed completion is a separately preserved supplement, never a weaker opponent.
